answer_1.quote: We propose cross‑modal attribute insertions ... Our method inserts attributes of objects that are both present in the image and mentioned in the text.
answer_1.outputs: augmented image captions and hypothesis sentences with inserted visual attributes

answer_2.quote: We quantify text‑to‑image retrieval performance using mean reciprocal rank (MRR). For cross‑modal entailment we report standard classification metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, and F1). We also compute mean cosine similarity Sim_T‑T′, BLEU and METEOR to compare the relevance of augmented text.

answer_4.quote: We recruit annotators using Amazon Mechanical Turk ... We asked annotators to indicate their agreement to the following question ... Rate the caption quality for the given image based on the reference examples shown earlier.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators responded to Likert‑scale questions comparing caption quality, accuracy and overall description quality of original vs. augmented captions.
